title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 13: the man of God from Judah who cried against the altar at Bethel, the old prophet's lie, and the lion on the road.

questions.text: From where did the man of God come to Bethel by Yahweh's word?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:1 says a man of God came out of Judah by Yahweh's word to Bethel.

questions.text: What was the name of the son of David's house who, the man of God said, would be born?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 13:2 the man of God says a son will be born to David's house, Josiah by name.

questions.text: What sign did the man of God give that same day?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:3 says the sign was that the altar would be split apart and the ashes on it would be poured out.

answers.text: Fire would come down from heaven on the altar
The calf of gold would fall on its face
The altar would be split apart and its ashes poured out
The sun would grow dark at noon

questions.text: What happened to Jeroboam's hand when he stretched it out and said, "Seize him!"?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:4 says his hand dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.

answers.text: It dried up so he could not draw it back
It became leprous, as white as snow
It was bitten by a snake
It was burned by fire from the altar

questions.text: What had Yahweh commanded the man of God about his journey?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 13:9 he says he was commanded to eat no bread, drink no water, and not return by the way that he came.

answers.text: Speak to no one until he reached Jerusalem
Shake the dust off his feet as he left
Eat no bread, drink no water, and don't return the same way
Stay in Bethel for seven days and fast

questions.text: Where did the old prophet find the man of God?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:14 says the old prophet went after the man of God and found him sitting under an oak.

questions.text: How did the old prophet persuade the man of God to come back with him?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 13:18 the old prophet says an angel spoke to him by Yahweh's word, telling him to bring the man back - but he lied to him.

answers.text: He falsely claimed an angel had told him to
He offered him half of his house
He said the king had commanded it
He said Yahweh had appeared to him in a dream

questions.text: What killed the man of God on his way home?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:24 says that when he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him.

questions.text: What did they say as they mourned over the man of God?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 13:30 says the old prophet laid the body in his own grave, and they mourned over him, saying, "Alas, my brother!"

questions.text: What did the old prophet ask his sons to do when he died?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 13:31 he tells his sons to bury him in the tomb where the man of God is buried, and to lay his bones beside his bones.

answers.text: Bury him beside the man of God
Burn his body on the altar
